# Runs the block up to max_attempts times, doubling the delay after each failure.
# The last exception is re-raised if all attempts fail.
def with_retry(max_attempts: 3, base_delay: 0.1, on: StandardError)
  raise ArgumentError, "max_attempts must be a positive integer" unless max_attempts.is_a?(Integer) && max_attempts.positive?
  raise ArgumentError, "base_delay must be non-negative" unless base_delay.is_a?(Numeric) && base_delay >= 0

  attempts = 0
  begin
    attempts += 1
    yield
  rescue *Array(on)
    raise if attempts >= max_attempts

    sleep(base_delay * (2**(attempts - 1)))
    retry
  end
end
